capitals.note: Placeholder after Antium's loss (confidence 1): the Privernum page (opened 2026-10-19) calls it 'a flourishing Volscian site' that the Romans 'conquered and destroyed' in the late 4th century BC and does not call it a capital.

correction.text: the Volscian country: Antium, the Pomptine plain, Privernum and the Liris valley (Latina and Frosinone provinces)

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria has no Volsci row; the page has no infobox area. Latina and Frosinone provinces (about 4,550 km2 by the gazetteer) overshoot the Aurunci and Ernici hills and include the Latin coast; soft edges. The wars with the Roman Kingdom (Tarquinius Superbus, 534-509: 'a number of wars against Rome's neighbours, including against the Volsci') and the Republic (493-446) are contests inside it.

correction.text: the Volscian country without Antium, which Rome conquered in 377

keyframe_review.note: Antium (Anzio) goes to Rome in 377 (roman-republic /ledger/3); the rest is annexed 'by 304 BC' and assimilated.

region.text: the Volscian country: Antium, the Pomptine plain, Privernum and the Liris valley

ledger.note: 534 BC: first appearance. Tarquinius Superbus (534-509) 'waged a number of wars against Rome's neighbours, including against the Volsci' (Roman Kingdom page); 'Tarquinius Superbus began the conflict with the Volsci and that the two states fought for about two centuries' (Volsci page). No page dates the Volscian descent into the plain; 534 is the start of the reign.

region.text: the Latin-Volscian border: Corioli, Velitrae, the Algidus pass

ledger.note: 493-446 BC: the Volscian wars. 'Coriolanus earns his cognomen after capturing Corioli' (493); Algidus 458 and Corbio 446 against 'the Aequi and Volsci' (expansion page). Drawn as one long contest on the Latin border.
446 BC: Corbio, the last dated battle; Volscian raids continue undated.

notes: New state. The Volsci are drawn as Latina and Frosinone provinces from Tarquinius Superbus' wars (534) to 'by 304 BC'; Antium goes to Rome in 377 (mirrors roman-republic). Wikidata unverified. Revised 2026-10-19 after review: roman-kingdom added to the Roman-Volscian wars' belligerents (the Roman Kingdom page: Tarquinius Superbus, 534-509, warred on the Volsci); keyframes added (Antium cut from 377); the Privernum page was opened and does not call it a capital (placeholder kept). The 304 loss still has no mirror in roman-republic (eu-03-b: add a gain from volsci in 304). Wikidata Q312513 could not be checked and is set to null.
